title: Book One · Chapter 4: The New Room
story:
The new home is behind a green gate.

Dad stops the cart outside it. Mum takes a key from her bag.

Ronan looks back down the road.

“Is this still River Street?”

“This is the next street,” Mum says. “We’re not far away.”

She opens the gate.

There is a small yard inside. A tap stands by the wall. Water falls from it into a bowl.

Drop. Drop. Drop.

Ronan looks for a tree.

There is no tree.

There is a plant in an old pot. It has three green leaves. One leaf has a hole in it.

“Something is eating our garden,” Dad says.

“That’s not a garden,” Ronan says.

“Not yet.”

Mum opens a door at the back of the yard.

“Here we are.”

The room smells of soap. Its walls are white. There is one window and a low shelf.

Ronan walks from the door to the window.

He counts his steps.

One, two, three, four, five.

Then he turns around.

“This room is small.”

“Yes, it is small,” Mum says.

There is a little room for cooking beside it. Mum puts the bag of bowls in there.

Dad brings in the pieces of the beds.

“Which side do you want?” he asks Ronan.

Ronan points to the window. Then he stops.

“Can I choose this side?”

“Yes. We’re asking you.”

Ronan looks out. He can see the yard and the plant.

“I want this side, please.”

Dad begins to put his bed together there.

Ronan brings in his own box. He opens it on the floor.

The boat is still green at one end. The book is still beside it. The bell is in the corner.

Nothing is broken.

He takes out the picture of the old room.

“Where can this go?”

Mum holds it against the wall above his bed.

“Here?”

“Please put it lower.”

She moves it down.

“Here?”

Ronan nods.

Mum puts the picture on the shelf for now.

“We need two small nails. Then we can hang it.”

Dad stands up. He moves Ronan’s bed a little. Then he sits on it.

It makes a loud sound.

Ronan looks worried.

Dad moves again. The bed makes the same sound.

“It knows me,” Dad says.

He stands up. Ronan sits down in his place.

The bed is quiet.

“It likes me more.”

“Good,” Dad says. “It’s your bed.”

Mum laughs from the little kitchen.

Ronan puts his boat and book on the shelf. He keeps the bell in his hand.

Something moves outside.

A black cat walks across the yard. It stops beside the pot and looks through the window.

Ronan looks back.

“We live here now,” he tells it.

The cat sits down.

Ronan puts the bell on the shelf. He leaves a little space beside it.

Then he takes his empty box to Mum.

“You can use this in the kitchen,” he says.

Mum puts a towel inside.

“Thank you.”

Outside, the tap still goes drop, drop, drop.

Ronan looks up at Dad.

“Can we fix that?”

Dad looks into the yard.

“Let’s ask first,” he says.
studyGuide:
## 先看情节提示也可以

一家人来到绿门后的新家；Ronan选了靠窗的床位，最后注意到水龙头还在滴水。

## 从认词到读句子

1. **The cat / sits down.** 猫／坐下来；这句不需要“对象”。
2. **Mum / puts a towel / inside.** 妈妈／放一条毛巾／放进箱子里；inside指箱内。

---

## 重点词句

| 表达 | 本章意思 |
|---|---|
| gate | 院子外面的门 |
| shelf | 架子 |
| tap | 水龙头 |
| lower | 更低；这里是“再往下点” |

旧词复现：yard、keep、space、bell、box、ask、put。

辅助理解：pot＝花盆；soap＝肥皂；drop＝水滴／滴答声。

“Not yet.”＝“还没有。”Dad 在这里把小小的盆栽说成一个未来的花园，是一句玩笑。

## 理解与回访

1. 新住处和原来的地方有什么不同？Ronan 自己决定了什么？
2. Ronan 最后注意到哪个问题？Dad 为什么说先问一问？

换个场景看旧词：*Is there enough space in the box?* space 在不同房间和箱子里都表示“空间”。
